healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the Asana personal access token (or OAuth token) by calling GET /users/me, using the literal "me" the API accepts for the caller's own user. Takes no input and returns the connector health status with the authenticated user's gid, name, and email. This call also returns the caller's workspaces, useful for resolving the workspace gid Create Task and Create Project need.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create a task. name is always required. workspace is required unless projects or parent is supplied — Asana can infer the workspace from either. The response includes permalinkUrl only when opt_fields requests it; pass optFields to get it back.

workspace.description: Workspace gid. Required unless projects or parent is given.

projects.description: Project gids to add the task to.

parent.description: Parent task gid, which makes this a subtask.

assignee.description: Who to assign the task to: a user gid, an email address, or the literal string "me".

assigneeSection.description: Section gid the task lands in within the assignee's My Tasks list.

dueOn.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD. Use dueAt instead for a specific time.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

completed.description: Create the task already marked complete.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include in the response, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Update a task. Omitted fields are left unchanged. To change project membership use Add Task to Section; this call does not accept a projects list.

assignee.description: Who to assign the task to: a user gid, an email address, or the literal string "me".

assigneeSection.description: Section gid the task lands in within the assignee's My Tasks list.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

completed.description: Mark the task complete or incomplete.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include in the response, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Fetch a single task by gid. Pass optFields (e.g. "permalink_url,notes") to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.listByProject.title: List Tasks by Project
tasks.listByProject.description: List the tasks in a project, ordered by priority within the project. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied, so this call always sends one. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

completedSince.description: Only tasks that are incomplete or were completed at or after this ISO 8601 time, or the literal "now" for only-incomplete.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.listSubtasks.title: List Subtasks
tasks.listSubtasks.description: List the direct subtasks of a task. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects, optionally scoped to a workspace. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

archived.description: Only archived (true) or only active (false) projects. Omit for both.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Fetch a single project by gid. Pass optFields (e.g. "permalink_url") to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a project in a workspace. team is required when the workspace is an organization.

workspace.description: Workspace gid the project is created in.

team.description: Team gid. Required when the workspace is an organization.

public.description: Whether the project is public to the workspace or organization.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

sections.list.title: List Sections
sections.list.description: List the sections of a project. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

sections.create.title: Create Section
sections.create.description: Create a section inside a project. Both the project and the section name are required.

projectGid.description: Project the section is created in.

insertBefore.description: Section gid to insert this section before.

insertAfter.description: Section gid to insert this section after.

sections.addTask.title: Add Task to Section
sections.addTask.description: Move a task into a section, removing it from the other sections of the same project. The task is inserted at the top of the section unless insertBefore or insertAfter is given. Asana answers this call with an empty object — there is no gid to read back, so the result echoes the section and task gids that were sent.

sectionGid.description: Section gid to add the task to.

task.description: Task gid to move into the section.

insertBefore.description: Task gid to insert this task before, within the section.

insertAfter.description: Task gid to insert this task after, within the section.

stories.listForTask.title: List Task Stories
stories.listForTask.description: List the story feed on a task — this includes both comments and system activity (field changes, assignments, and so on). Filter on resource_subtype == "comment_added" to get just the human comments. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

stories.create.title: Comment on Task
stories.create.description: Add a comment to a task, posted as a new story. text (or htmlText for rich text) is required.

isPinned.description: Pin the comment to the top of the task.

workspaces.list.title: List Workspaces
workspaces.list.description: List the workspaces and organizations the caller can access. Needed to resolve the workspace gid Create Task and Create Project require. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "is_organization".

tasks.delete.title: Delete Task
tasks.delete.description: Permanently delete a task. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task gid that was sent. This cannot be undone.

tasks.search.title: Search Tasks
tasks.search.description: Search tasks in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspace}/tasks/search. workspace is required. This endpoint does not use Asana's offset pagination — it returns up to 100 compact tasks matching the filters. Premium workspaces only.

text.description: Full-text search across task name and description.

completed.description: Only completed (true) or only incomplete (false) tasks.

assignee.description: Maps to assignee.any: a user gid, an email, or the literal "me".

project.description: Maps to projects.any: a project gid.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.addProject.title: Add Task to Project
tasks.addProject.description: Add a task to a project (or move it within a project) via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/addProject. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task and project gids that were sent. Optional section, insertBefore, and insertAfter control placement.

project.description: Project gid to add the task to.

insertBefore.description: Task gid to insert this task before.

insertAfter.description: Task gid to insert this task after.

tasks.removeProject.title: Remove Task from Project
tasks.removeProject.description: Remove a task from a project via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/removeProject. The task is not deleted. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task and project gids that were sent.

project.description: Project gid to remove the task from.

stories.get.title: Get Story
stories.get.description: Fetch a single story (comment or system activity) by gid. Pass optFields to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "html_text".

users.me.title: Get Current User
users.me.description: Fetch the authenticated user via GET /users/me, using the literal "me" the API accepts for the caller's own user. Returns the user object including workspaces, useful for resolving gids other operations need.

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List users in a workspace. workspace and limit are required — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied, and listing users without a workspace is not useful. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached. limit must be between 1 and 100.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "email".

tags.create.title: Create Tag
tags.create.description: Create a tag in a workspace. name and workspace are required.

workspace.description: Workspace gid the tag is created in.

tags.list.title: List Tags
tags.list.description: List tags in a workspace. workspace and limit are required — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached. limit must be between 1 and 100.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

attachments.create.title: Create Attachment
attachments.create.description: Attach an external URL to a task via POST /attachments. This is a URL attachment (resource_subtype external), not a multipart file upload — file uploads are out of scope for the declarative template. taskGid and url are required. Optional name is shown in Asana.

taskGid.description: Task gid to attach to (maps to parent).
